### 💥 BREAKING CHANGES
- due to [`9f7ccef`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/9f7ccef37c5e6514719e16d6a94b24507a0ffb0c) - Update minimum Android version to 7.0, update dependencies *(PR #134 by @aliernfrog)*:

  LAC Tool now requires at least Android 7.0 due to new AndroidX dependency requirements


### ✨ New Features
- [`9f7ccef`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/9f7ccef37c5e6514719e16d6a94b24507a0ffb0c) - Update minimum Android version to 7.0, update dependencies *(PR #134 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`16a541b`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/16a541b40243f45a096e631a41b50fede9f53598) - **Shizuku**: Recommend thedjchi fork and support its hiding feature *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`e9223c2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/e9223c24563f7db534525f5bd643ac8ec686f977) - Improve Issues & Feedback section in About page, improve expandable row *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`484a9f1`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/484a9f17fd229284c152b26053b697b90af5a288) - **Crash handler**: Ability to leave a message for crash reports *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`aa630da`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/aa630da0f7f6eca43d9322f6e12eeda877e160c8) - **Maps**: Improve search bar and move style button out of it *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`49b0437`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/49b0437045b569c3eab1252a22440ec97aa69d39) - **Maps**: Ability to download maps from URL *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`ce81b57`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/ce81b57f88b0a173d404232eac392f336061af75) - Floating navigation bar, opt-in blur effects, draw content behind keyboard *(PR #154 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`a0a858e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/a0a858ef9e3d36ebad73e0129ee8ed239af8a3cd) - **Maps**: Refresh list style options UI, fix thumbnails disappearing and reappearing on reload *(PR #156 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`4256808`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/4256808236307e6b05778e1afc46932c8fc8261c) - **l10n**: Update translations *(PR #157 by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`09860db`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/09860db96f9ece78e08a0f106a96291b58dab954) - Add extra spacing to bottom of pages to improve visibility *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`76b68ed`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/76b68ed18b1d910625d719d627a27f961d7fb3a8) - Correctly handle new intents *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`52c93b6`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/52c93b69b7ae0b90f59f1266c47321e392e6914f) - **Crash details sheet**: Prevent sheet from re-opening on configuration change *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`cadcb6c`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/cadcb6c425857c93cceed7f31de6f7a28a0bb7a3) - **Progress dialog**: Janky cancel button animation *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`543ac8e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/543ac8e17cbcc232fe074d38ff2c34671d412205) - **Maps list**: Fix various issues caused by separation of FAB *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`e37e425`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/e37e425cfd45f4cf546442c9022bec581090da67) - **Shizuku**: Do not show warning when using other forks, add link to forks list *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`5d93f1f`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/5d93f1f03e40c177ba2a8b4f6f00c98e082720c6) - Update file sharing for upcoming Android changes *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`66e5e14`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/66e5e14752809e6e6d28a72a9b64bcd788edfd18) - **Fading edge**: Automatically match background and determine RTL status *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`fef5ffd`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/fef5ffdf207c6e408e6dfb8be575731c694be18d) - **Updates**: Remove misleading incompatible version warning *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ✨ New Features
- [`0e6ec95`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/0e6ec95e4eb5f5302548cb19162ba993ccee3dcd) - Improve and update credits *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`83bc0c2`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/83bc0c23deeba75167910321a11f5f4520597a05) - **SAF**: Catch errors when checking for URI permissions *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`6b8a987`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/6b8a987e4c30b1158db8a12685f54f8ea4c730e8) - Handle DocumentsUI being disabled/uninstalled *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ✨ New Features
- [`e9d010b`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/e9d010b614b0308ea7ef644b09aa4819bb1ae332) - **Map editor**: AI navmesh objects configuration *(PR #146 by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`c156c0f`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/c156c0f58a25fb81cd3d6c80f8042020a432785a) - **Shared strings**: Data class based resolving instead of key lookup *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ✨ New Features
- [`d029614`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/d029614178348ead69cb73d4249a4976ef84f2d9) - **Maps merge screen**: Add elevation to toolbar *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`9d55925`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/9d55925a45490f73f61e773d36e406879a6e83aa) - **Media overlay**: Toolbar animation and elevation, adapt system bars to light theme *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`4900311`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/4900311aa2a6cf0d8e36d6b88a946d0843b2522e) - UI improvements *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`5d01608`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/5d01608c59bd9aa23c87421e9bf5bd0c3db6cd8a) - Ability to report caught errors *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`99ea966`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/99ea9666d679d8b90078f6049d0d724c8fab1cee) - **Maps list**: Separate pager and header *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`5cb4c87`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/5cb4c87045c5dde0c6c47f0e01263bf6cd98ce93) - **Maps**: Option to dismiss thumbnail backup reminder permanently *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`42084a7`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/42084a7bb3558d65dd489e9245a289af8096e18a) - **Map materials**: Improve UI and UX *(PR #143 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`8aebeab`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/8aebeabaaa7320b6afa3247c7dfa86d0697397fa) - Improve toast contrast and animations *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`7226b9b`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/7226b9b2f595d691acaab77d389515f040265fc4) - **Map editor**: Float options support, validate options before saving *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- [`842cd19`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/842cd1945d95d7a319ccf0c7dd71a53f5b795784) - **Permissions**: Check if given path is a directory *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c845631`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/c84563116650340b8628cf971178e8cd93cbde87) - **Updates screen**: Use latest release info, add missing elevation to toolbar *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`bd1ad50`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/bd1ad5030b7515c410c75d7ce9064724c50f9150) - **Updates**: Restore update badge on settings button *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`674beda`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/674bedadbe60917e0c5c729a4e62619dddc69e14) - **Maps**: Force thumbnail to reload when thumbnail file is set *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`c03478e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/c03478ec3d21e4fa3c8f417b4b9f47829aab938a) - **Maps**: Avoid duplicating navigation entry *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`4c23f36`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/4c23f3631dbd7b259e5e3d60169c91e3c623263b) - **Maps**: Hide thumbnail viewer toolbar when the map is not imported *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`140a72d`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/140a72d564a6022426d114db9bb7413ede1d7fd6) - **Updates screen**: Do not show open in browser label if not enough space *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`5cb2820`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/5cb2820d30d802ce7e2d716e2ee7af3ed6246390) - **FAB**: Adjust label visibility animation *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`a65d58e`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/a65d58e250349457921d4ca70fc85bf1b544dcb4) - **Map merging**: Show select/deselect all option when multi-selecting *(commit by @aliernfrog)*
- [`9b83b24`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/9b83b24554d3a91b0e4f91d1cedb4c153a09665d) - **Map editor**: Do not show "ghost" role when roles list is blank *(commit by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`3c7135a`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/3c7135a05ddc94ce5b49de50a8856a05adbd9932) - Correct ViewModel handling by using domains and `viewModelOf` *(PR #141 by @aliernfrog)*

# Note
This release includes major refactors to improve state management and move shared code across my apps to reusable modules/libraries. Issues are expected, you can report them on [Issues](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/issues) or on [Discord](https://aliernfrog.github.io/discord).

### ✨ New Features
- [`321ded5`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/321ded5e7298afbeeb6792f0fba87ca53c975ffd) - Fix crash when merging maps on scoped storage, add crash handler, support links, better changelog viewer and improve update control system *(PR #136 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`3dddac9`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/3dddac9a287093ac4e488811e7309b0543b9b0f6) - Add tooltips to all icon buttons *(PR #137 by @aliernfrog)*
- [`901e817`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/901e817c5ffa8aaba5c86f00808dc9d18c4d95c5) - **l10n**: Update translations *(PR #135 by @aliernfrog)*

### ♻️ Refactors
- [`88cca66`](https://github.com/aliernfrog/lac-tool/commit/88cca66813375838c3331ce99f3e7413deaa0806) - Use shared module from `aliernfrog/pf-tool` to avoid duplicate code *(PR #131 by @aliernfrog)*
